title: What 'frame still uncut' means for IRQHandler_RcCalib; inventory of remaining non-C in g2/src/em9305

irqhandler_rccalib_frame.meaning: Stock 0x3064fc is one function: the 88-byte register save (r0-r12, r30, blink, r58/r59, lp_count, aux lp_start/lp_end/1411/1409), the RC-calib body inlined, then restore and rtie. The tree uses EM_IRQ_HANDLER: the same save/restore is a shared inline-asm template in em_irq_frame.h, and the typo'd body would live in a separate C function reached by bl. That is a few bytes larger than stock, puts an extra blink save and a body prologue/epilogue on the stack during the body, and is the same pattern used by all 16 wave-28 IRQ handlers (RadioRx/Tx also note the last aux register is saved before the call, not in the delay slot). Wave 28 harness-checked the lowered body (60 qemu-arc tests); the comment on every handler says the frame itself is not covered. 'Frame still uncut' means the entry-point symbol has not been made a single inlined-body handler and has not been proved as a whole (save + body + restore + rtie) against stock, so typo-RAM of the body was left uninstalled.
what_would_cut_it: Inline the typo'd C body between EM_IRQ_SAVE and EM_IRQ_RESTORE so opencfw_em9305_IRQHandler_RcCalib is one function with no _body thunk, matching stock control flow (no bl).
Extend the qemu-arc harness to compare that complete handler, including rtie and aux 1409/1411, against lowered stock, EQUIVALENT 100, with typo-site mutants killed.
Only then typo-install the body and run private pbuild + paired sims.
why_not_this_turn: em_irq_frame.h documents that the ARC gcc interrupt attribute does not emit this stock frame, so a pure-C handler is not available.

C statements inside a naked function (the only way to suppress gcc's own prologue and still end in rtie) are unsupported. A linker script can place sections but cannot emit the stock prologue or turn a C function's j [blink] epilogue into fall-through into RESTORE.
Changing the shared EM_IRQ_HANDLER template would affect all 16 handlers plus the unused-vector handler stock_30f170, and would need a full-handler proof for each.

Proving the complete handler needs harness support for rtie / those aux registers. That lives in build/em-ctl/qm.py and the QEMU-ARC compare, which this stream does not own (notes would go in pending/).

Therefore typo-RAM of IRQHandler_RcCalib was not installed. Tree file still literals, sha 23d53bafe7d14a3e20c0740dc952e5df5d595dcf22218fefa12e76d48a9299e0. Workspace prove remains valid for the body only.

IRQ typo literals (RcCalib, PmlSvld, ArcTimer0/1, GPIO, protocol/sleep timers, SWI7) stay uninstalled while frames are uncut.
